answer: Cap rewards by funding origin, not by key. When a new agent joins, the ledger records where its first deposit came from. Each epoch, payouts pass through that record like light through a prism: identities whose deposits trace back to the same jetty, one wallet or one withdrawal batch, are split out as a single band and share one reward. A farm of a hundred keys funded from one source stays a hollow crowd earning what one honest agent earns, while independently funded agents keep full pay.
